BiblicalUsage: Atroth-shophan was one of the towns the children of Gad built when they settled east of the Jordan, named once in the list of their cities. It appears only here.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the towns Gad built were homes for families who had chosen the far side of the river, and the record keeps their names.
